objective: Evaluate whether natural-language explanations generated from a frozen IDS decision and its SHAP evidence are grounded in the model evidence, factually consistent with the supplied prediction/features, understandable, useful, and generated with acceptable latency. This is an explainability evaluation, not another predictive experiment.

explanation_path.explained_decision: frozen primary Model B (binary deployment detector) decision on final-test alerts
explanation_path.production_endpoint_note: the existing production /explain path (app/api/predict -> app/ml/inference.predict) is tied to Model A (multiclass supervised + anomaly). For the deployment alert evaluation, Model B needed a SHAP path.
explanation_path.model_b_shap_support: added read-only via xgboost booster pred_contribs (training/phase17d_explain_sample.py); Model B weights, threshold, feature schema and predictive behaviour are unchanged.

shap.top_k_rule: fixed k=5, matching the pre-existing frozen value in app/ml/inference.py; chosen before any explanation quality was seen

evidence_contract.ground_truth_use: recorded separately in sample_manifest.json for evaluation only; never supplied to the LLM

provider.primary_rationale: the repository's designated default provider (app/core/config settings.llm_provider='gemini'); reused as primary rather than opening a provider competition
provider.fallback: claude (claude-sonnet-5) — implementation fallback only, not a second research arm
provider.real_calls_status: NOT YET RUN; gated on approval and API cost

prompt.structure: prose, 3-5 sentences (existing deployed v3 template), not JSON fields
prompt.structured_fields_deviation: the protocol recommended JSON fields (summary/model_decision/key_evidence/interpretation/uncertainty/action); the existing defensible v3 prose template was reused instead to avoid changing deployed behaviour. Structural completeness is checked against v3's mandated prose elements (decision statement, evidence reference, verification/uncertainty).
grounding_rules_present: distinguishes model classification from proven fact
confidence is model confidence, not attack probability

sample.rule: deterministic; benign FP alerts sampled from all benign flows Model B flagged ATTACK (pool of 85); PortScan TP alerts sampled from the first 2000 selector-matched evaluable flows of eval-v1-portscan-001; both with seed 42. Selected before any explanation was inspected.
sample.final_test_reuse_justification: predictive models and threshold are already frozen and no model selection occurs, so frozen final-test alerts may be reused for explanation evaluation.

automated_groundedness.direction_consistency_limitation: scores only unambiguous feature windows and abstains when adjacent features' direction words collide; free-prose direction attribution is inherently limited and is complemented by the human instrument.

shap_vs_no_shap_baseline.design: same provider/prompt/sample; condition A = prediction + SHAP evidence, condition B = prediction only (empty SHAP). One controlled comparison, not a prompt-engineering study.

latency.shap_computation_ms: measured per alert in phase17d_explain_sample.py (median recorded in sample_manifest.json)
latency.total_explanation_ms: shap + llm, recorded by the batch runner

h4_status_rule.current_status_reason: automated technical-groundedness infrastructure and the fixed sample are frozen, but no real LLM explanations have been generated and no human ratings have been collected; H4 cannot be concluded yet.

secrets_policy: no API keys stored in reports or git; keys come from environment / .env (gitignored)
